text:
Liam: FYI inbound from @support — customer says promo code is rejected as invalid/expired but dashboard shows it active. Email: acme.support@acme.com Code: REDWOOD50X. They hit the API during checkout and got a generic 'invalid' response. Screenshot attached.

Ava: Thanks — can you paste the API error payload or curl so we have a repro? Also did they try via dashboard apply (manual) or only API?

Liam: They tried both. Dashboard apply shows code present, 0 redemptions, expiry 2026-12-31. Repro curl from customer (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/promos/redeem \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"code":"REDWOOD50X","email":"acme.support@acme.com"}'
```
Response:
```json
{"error":"PROMO_SIG_INVALID","message":"signature verification failed"}
```

Ravi: :eyes: That error isn't typical for expiry. Looks like the promo signature HMAC verification failed server-side. Pulling promo-service logs now.

Ravi: Log excerpt from promo-service (sanitized):
```
ERROR [2025-11-18T14:12:07Z] validate_promo: code=REDWOOD50X key_id="rotated_v2" result=signature_mismatch err="hmac verify failed"
WARN  [2025-11-18T14:12:07Z] promo-sign-migration: migration_job_id=20251118-3 status=failed exit_code=1 msg="partial re-sign completed"
```

promo-bot: migration event recorded -> promo-sign-migration job 20251118-3 failed on host node-g5-12 at 2025-11-18T14:11:59Z. Affected: legacy campaign ids [cam_92, cam_103].

Ravi: Root cause hypothesis: last night we rotated the signing key (rotated_v2) and kicked a re-sign job that was supposed to re-sign legacy codes. The job errored, leaving some codes still signed with the old key while the service now verifies only rotated_v2. So dashboard (which reads DB metadata) shows code active, but redeem verifies signature and fails.

Priya: If that's true, we should offer an immediate manual credit to the customer. How many affected codes did the migration touch? Any chance of mass impact?

Ravi: Early telemetry shows ~1200 codes across the two campaigns touched; but only a subset have been attempted by customers so far. We can do a targeted re-sign for the specific code or re-run the migration. Quick mitigation: enable legacy-key fallback verification for a short window, then re-run the re-sign job. I'll coordinate with eng-infra for the rollout.

Ava: I'll message the customer with a temporary workaround (manual credit) and request permission to apply it while we fix. Draft: "Sorry about the trouble — we can apply a one-time $200 credit to your account immediately while we fix the promo validation. Would you like us to apply that now?"

Priya: Approve $200 manual credit now; I'll apply it and note case. Please include invoice/org id in the ticket.

Ravi: Plan of action:
- Turn on legacy-key fallback verification (config flag) — target 10m window (hotfix)
- Re-run promo-sign-migration with stricter retry and validation (post-migration sanity check)
- Remove fallback after successful re-sign and publish postmortem
ETA: fallback in 20-30m, migration rerun + validation in next 2 hours.

Ava: I'll tell the customer: enable credit now and we'll notify when the promo redeems normally. Also ask them to retry after 20m.

Liam: Customer approved immediate credit. Priya please post the internal billing note and apply $200.

Priya: Done — applied credit txn id TXN-20251118-ACME-42 and added case note.

Ravi: Rolling out fallback flag to canary now, will post logs when done.

Ravi: Fallback enabled on canary at 14:34Z — canary redeem test for REDWOOD50X returned 200 OK and redemption succeeded. Rolling to prod.

promo-bot: promo-sign-migration job rerun scheduled -> job 20251118-3-retry started at 2025-11-18T14:41:12Z.

Ravi: Migration rerun completed and sanity checks show signatures normalized for cam_92 and cam_103. Removing fallback in 10m after observation window.

Ava: Customer notified, accepted credit, will retry tomorrow morning and confirm. I'll close the external case once they confirm or after 24h.

Liam: Thanks team — please add postmortem once written. Marking this thread for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
